note: The single list of languages the product ships or intends to ship. Agents read this to know every locale a new or changed key must be translated into. tests/unit/i18n/test_language_manifest.py fails when a language here is missing an English key without a shrink-only i18n/coverage-allowance.json entry. `native` is the language's own name in its own script, `english` is the English name, `dir` is its text direction, and `status` is `source` for the English source or `supported` for a target locale.
